inheritance: All discrete-module histories, global continuous-colour results, negative present-day abiotic species-proxy gates, chun Cirsium claim gate, JPN38 permission/licensing routes, JPN29 specimen-identity blocker, and the frozen original Japan5 negative result from v13 remain in force unless explicitly updated below.

crop_harmonized_direct_evidence.interpretation: Applying the frozen Azami production detector/crop stage to every current licensed direct image removes the previous source-processing mismatch. JPN05 now clears the two-locality gate and becomes the sixth clean Japan-local continuous-colour concept. JPN30 remains admitted but its L* shifts upward by 3.8235 units relative to the earlier whole-image proxy.

harmonized5.interpretation: Replacing only JPN30 with its production-crop proxy makes the already weak local negative signal approximately zero. The frozen Japan5 negative conclusion is therefore not an artifact of the earlier whole-image JPN30 proxy.

expanded6.interpretation: Adding independently admitted JPN05 does not recover the global anti-phylogenetic lightness pattern; the six-concept estimate is slightly positive and unstable under leave-one-out.

colour.current_inference: Across the frozen five-concept baseline, the production-crop harmonized five-concept sensitivity, and the independently expanded six-concept panel, there is no supported Japan-local anti-phylogenetic L* structure. The strong global species-proxy lightness overdispersion must remain separated from the Japan-radiation history.
colour.status: Six identity-resolved Japan-local continuous-colour concepts are now admitted, with direct-image sources harmonized to the frozen Azami detector/crop/colour pipeline. Both H5 and E6 exact tests are negative. Discrete W/C transition history remains blocked.

priority_reordering.first: Retain all three local tests as frozen results: original Japan5, crop-harmonized H5, and expanded E6. Do not choose among them post hoc based on significance.
priority_reordering.second: Before acquiring more external images, re-audit all 14 exact Japan38 concepts already present in the frozen 46,276-observation Azami strict-spatial cohort for Japan-window colour observations and independent locality cells. Some low-depth exact concepts may already contain admissible Japan-local detector-crop evidence that was ignored by the earlier n>=5 high-depth gate.
priority_reordering.third: For any newly recovered exact concept, require identity resolution plus at least two independent Japan-local locality/date or spatial-cell replicates under a predeclared aggregation rule before adding it to the local history panel. Preserve the six-concept result as baseline for the next expansion.
priority_reordering.fourth: Keep JPN38 permission and JPN29 specimen identity as parallel routes only after exhausting already-generated detector-crop evidence. Do not discretize colour or infer W/C transition direction while continuous local structure remains coverage-limited and unsupported.
priority_reordering.do_not_repeat: Do not lower detector or colour-confidence thresholds, revert to whole-image colour because it is more favorable, remove sign-changing taxa, or search alternate transformations on the same panel.

claim_boundary: The absence of supported anti-phylogenetic L* structure across the current Japan-local panels does not prove that colour has not evolved repeatedly or adaptively. It shows that the earlier global species-level overdispersion signal cannot be promoted to a Japan-radiation conclusion under current identity-resolved, population-local evidence. No ancestral colour, discrete W/C transition, convergence, adaptive radiation or molecular reactivation is inferred.
